summary: Master blockchain for social protection. Learn to automate benefits, secure digital identity, and reduce fraud using smart contracts and DLT. Enroll today.
lede: Blockchain Technology in Social Protection Administration helps professionals apply distributed ledger technology to beneficiary registries, benefit disbursements, and digital identity management. The course shows how to create immutable audit trails, reduce administrative overhead, and strengthen the delivery of assistance to intended recipients. You will work with Hyperledger Fabric, Ethereum, zero-knowledge proofs, smart contracts, and consensus mechanisms in practical social protection contexts. You will also develop blockchain readiness audits and a multi-year roadmap for integration while addressing privacy, limited connectivity, data localization, fraud, and cross-agency interoperability.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals tasked with modernizing social safety nets and ensuring the integrity of public assistance programs through advanced digital tools.
modules: Foundations of DLT in Social Policy
Governance and Consensus in Public Ledgers
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of social protection systems or public administration. Prior experience with digital databases or management information systems (MIS) is recommended. No advanced programming knowledge is required, though familiarity with basic digital transformation concepts is beneficial.
